data.description:
GitHub Actions periodic ops sweep window 2026-09-02T17:00:00Z..2026-09-20T05:05:00Z found the latest main run of `Terraform Drift` failing on main.

Evidence:
- Workflow: Terraform Drift
- Run: https://github.com/navapbc/rebar/actions/runs/35427050073
- Run id: 35427050073
- Event: schedule
- Head branch/SHA: main @ 8f7417079ade1132038a6e0dd24216e8c71aa706
- Failed job: `plan`, job id 105854709957
- Failed step: `terraform plan (fail on drift)`
- Exact error repeated for required inputs: `Error: No value for required variable`
- Missing variables reported in the failed log include `bedrock_daily_cap_usd`, `bedrock_warn_threshold_usd`, `bedrock_cap_seed_rates`, and `bedrock_cap_unknown_rate_per_1k`.
- Same signature also occurred in workflow-dispatch run 35418919284 on the same head SHA before the scheduled run.

This affects main's operational CI signal: Terraform Drift cannot evaluate the live configuration, so it cannot distinguish real drift from an unevaluable plan.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `Terraform Drift` on `main` supplies concrete values for the Bedrock spend-cap variables or gives them safe defaults committed with the Terraform configuration.
- [ ] A fresh `Terraform Drift` run on `main` reaches a plan verdict instead of failing with `No value for required variable`.
- [ ] The workflow summary preserves the distinction between real Terraform drift and plan-generation failures.

## Verification

Inspect or run a fresh `Terraform Drift` workflow on `main` and confirm the `plan` job no longer fails for missing `bedrock_*` input variables.
data.title: Terraform Drift is red on main because new Bedrock spend-cap variables have no CI values
